title: Posting of temporary use certificate.
officialText:
The temporary use certificate shall be posted in a conspicuous location on, or
adjacent to, the device covered by the certificate and shall state that the device has not been finally approved by the
commissioner.
SECTION BC 3010
ELEVATOR, AMUSEMENT AND OTHER DEVICE
OPERATORS
